RansomwareSettings.title: RansomwareSettings
RansomwareSettings.description:
Read by the detection workers on every file event (correlators.py):
typed here, because a malformed value used to reach them as stored -- a
string of globs was iterated character by character (a lone "*" matched
every file write and fired the tripwire), a non-numeric threshold failed
every batch of the organization's events.
